SHIONTHEBRUISER-MONSTER_ORB.title: Monster Orb
SHIONTHEBRUISER-MONSTER_ORB.description:
[gold]Passive:[/gold] At the start of your turn, for each enemy intent, gain:
Attack: [gold]Block[/gold].
Debuff: [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Counter Strategy[/gold].
Anything else: Energy.
[gold]Evoke:[/gold] Gain ALL of these once.
